versions.description: A stock market that cannot print money. Some stocks move with real server activity (monster kills, player deaths, players online, teleports), others move at random. Prices are pulled back to a base price, stay between a floor and a ceiling and move at most a set percent per update. Every trade pays a fee into a pool that is paid back as dividends to shareholders, with a bonus for long holders. Sell lock after buying, max shares per player, news only after a move.

commands.name: market
commands.description: List all stocks with price and last move.
commands.helpText: Shows every stock, its price and its last move.

commands.name: stock
commands.helpText: stock <ticker>: price, range, what moves it, recent prices and your holding.

commands.name: buy
commands.helpText: buy <ticker> <shares>: buy shares at the current price plus the fee.

commands.name: sell
commands.helpText: sell <ticker> <shares|all>: sell at the current price minus the fee.

commands.name: portfolio
commands.helpText: Shows your holdings, their value, profit, sell locks and hold streaks.

commands.name: marketadmin
commands.helpText: Fees in, dividends out, fee pool, money in the market, top holders, activity signals (STOCK_ADMIN).

hooks.name: on-entity-killed
on-player-death
hooks.description: Counts player deaths for deaths-driven stocks.

hooks.name: on-command-executed
hooks.description: Counts teleport commands for travel-driven stocks.

cronJobs.name: update-prices
cronJobs.description: Moves prices (signals + noise + pull back), then posts news for big moves.

cronJobs.name: pay-dividends
cronJobs.description: Pays part of the fee pool to shareholders, with a hold-streak bonus.

functions.name: stx-helpers

permissions.description: Allows marketadmin (fees in, dividends out, money in the market).
Lowers the trade fee by the count in percent (count 50 = half fee).
Max shares per stock for this player (count). Overrides the config value.
